puck_pinhole_camera — DRIVE puck op

• Data kinds: table × scalar × scalar × signal → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.puck_pinhole_camera(table: 'dict', height: 'float', fovy_deg: 'float', shape) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import puck; puck.puck_pinhole_camera(table: 'dict', height: 'float', fovy_deg: 'float', shape) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("puck_pinhole_camera"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

真上の針穴カメラ(位置 (0, 0, h)、−z を見る、up = +y、MuJoCo のカメラ規約)をホモグラフィに: col = W/2 + f x/h、row = H/2 − f y/h、f = (H/2)/tan(fovy/2)。パック上面の高さ(≈ 0.02 m)は無視(視差 h に対して 1 % 強、残差は門で測る)。shape = (H, W)。返り値は puck_camera と同じ形。
